the assessment of the creativity of a computational system should be based on its output as well as on its behaviour, and that a framework which allows the description of this behaviour may contribute to the perception of the creativity of the system.

we have developed a new framework for describing the behaviour of programs which generate creative artefacts.

the perception of creativity is not a simple matter of the output, but also of the behaviour of the system.

the perception of the creativity of a program can only be enhanced by providing the audience of its output with a better understanding of how it works.
